<!-- =========================================================================
     RESEARCH DESIGN BLOCK: CRISPR GENE EDITING STUDIO

     ========================================================================= -->
<div class="block-crispr-studio rounded-3xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800/80 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col select-none"
     hx-state='{ "targetGene": "HBB", "targetLocus": "chr11:5,227,002", "editMode": "hdr", "onTargetScore": 88, "offTargetScore": 94, "gcContent": 55.0, "activePam": "TGG" }'>

  <!-- ZONE 1: BLOCK HEADER -->
  <div class="px-5 py-3.5 bg-slate-900/90 border-b border-slate-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
      <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-purple-600/20 border border-purple-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-purple-400 font-black text-sm">
        ✂️
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-purple-400">CRISPR-Cas Precision Studio</span>
          <span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-extrabold bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/20">SpCas9 (NGG)</span>
        </div>
        <h2 class="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <span hx-text="'Target Gene: ' + targetGene + ' (Exon 1)'">Target Gene: HBB (Exon 1)</span>
          <span class="text-slate-500">•</span>
          <span class="text-xs text-slate-300 font-normal">HbS E6V Sickle Mutation (<span class="font-mono text-purple-300" hx-text="targetLocus">chr11:5,227,002</span>)</span>
        </h2>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Editing Modality Switcher -->
    <div class="flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-950 p-1 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 text-xs font-black">
      <button class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl transition-all"
              hx-class='{ "bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-purple-600/30": editMode === "nhej", "text-slate-400 hover:text-white": editMode !== "nhej" }'
              hx-action="editMode = 'nhej'; $appz.haptic('selection')">NHEJ Knockout</button>
      <button class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl transition-all"
              hx-class='{ "bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-purple-600/30": editMode === "hdr", "text-slate-400 hover:text-white": editMode !== "hdr" }'
              hx-action="editMode = 'hdr'; $appz.haptic('selection')">HDR Template</button>
      <button class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl transition-all"
              hx-class='{ "bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-purple-600/30": editMode === "base", "text-slate-400 hover:text-white": editMode !== "base" }'
              hx-action="editMode = 'base'; $appz.haptic('selection')">Base Editor (ABE)</button>
      <button class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl transition-all"
              hx-class='{ "bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-purple-600/30": editMode === "prime", "text-slate-400 hover:text-white": editMode !== "prime" }'
              hx-action="editMode = 'prime'; $appz.haptic('selection')">Prime pegRNA</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ZONE 2: CALIBRATION & TOOLBAR -->
  <div class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-slate-900/40 border-b border-slate-800/80 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
    <!-- Quick Target Gene Presets -->
    <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
      <span class="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 mr-1">Disease Target</span>
      <button class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl font-bold font-mono transition-all"
              hx-class='{ "bg-purple-600 text-white": targetGene === "HBB", "bg-slate-900 text-slate-400": targetGene !== "HBB" }'
              hx-action="targetGene = 'HBB'; targetLocus = 'chr11:5,227,002'; onTargetScore = 88; offTargetScore = 94; $appz.haptic('selection')">
        HBB (Sickle Cell)
      </button>
      <button class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl font-bold font-mono transition-all"
              hx-class='{ "bg-purple-600 text-white": targetGene === "CCR5", "bg-slate-900 text-slate-400": targetGene !== "CCR5" }'
              hx-action="targetGene = 'CCR5'; targetLocus = 'chr3:46,373,450'; onTargetScore = 92; offTargetScore = 89; $appz.haptic('selection')">
        CCR5 (Δ32 HIV)
      </button>
      <button class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl font-bold font-mono transition-all"
              hx-class='{ "bg-purple-600 text-white": targetGene === "CFTR", "bg-slate-900 text-slate-400": targetGene !== "CFTR" }'
              hx-action="targetGene = 'CFTR'; targetLocus = 'chr7:117,559,590'; onTargetScore = 81; offTargetScore = 96; $appz.haptic('selection')">
        CFTR (F508del)

      <button class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl font-bold font-mono transition-all"

              hx-action="targetGene = 'DMD'; targetLocus = 'chrX:31,180,200'; onTargetScore = 85; offTargetScore = 91; $appz.haptic('selection')">
        DMD (Exon 51)
      </button>
    </div>

    <!-- Protocol Parameter Badges -->
    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
      <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">Enzyme:</span>
      <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 font-mono font-bold text-purple-400 text-xs">SpCas9 (20 nt + NGG)</span>
      <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">Nickase:</span>
      <span class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">Wild-Type DSB</span>
    </div>
  </div>
